Editing and deletion feel right. Permanent deletion with a clear confirmation is enough; I don’t need a separate trash area. The duplicate rules also match my expectations, including treating different query strings as potentially different pages.

When an address changes, keep my tags and note attached, but fetch the new page’s details and capture a fresh saved copy. Keeping the old page copy under the new address would be misleading. Otherwise, these management flows work for me.
